storyCards.headline: Mr Wrong: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Mary J. Blige's "Mr Wrong" reached #87 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #87 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Mr Wrong was released in 2011.

Album: My Life II...The Journey Continues (Act 1) (2011).
